location.label: Golden Gate Park Polo Fields — authored 4 ha managed-turf subset
location.geometry_status: Same schematic subset as water packet; no surveyed polygon or validated electrical layout.

site_area_m2.note: Authored site area inherited unchanged; not building floor area.

average_it_load_mw.note: Already an average. No additional utilization factor.

operation_days.note: First full non-leap year, no ramp-up.

annual_site_electricity_pue.note: Transferred SJ04 design average used as an authored annual site-electricity ratio. Original uses design loads/weather; not measured SF performance or a peak factor.

cooling_makeup_l_per_kwh_it.note: Inherited cooling make-up intensity. Supply includes blowdown; not evaporative consumption or the LBNL site-WUE boundary.

comparison.reason: No matched SF design/weather pair established. Explain alternatives qualitatively; do not promise a fixed water-saving electricity penalty.

electrical_boundary.normal_operation: Site electrical energy at the campus service boundary, including IT and supporting systems. Entire modelled normal-operation electricity supplied from the grid; no solar/battery/generator supply credits.
electrical_boundary.construction: Selected on-site diesel and assumed grid-electricity allowances only. No embodied energy or complete lifecycle total.
electrical_boundary.non_it: Cooling plus electrical losses and other support systems. Cooling-only split unknown.

grid_context.eligible_service_context: City-owned-property development must apply for Hetch Hetchy Power according to SFPUC; approval and service route are not established.
grid_context.distribution_context: SFPUC describes Hetch Hetchy service points involving PG&E distribution. CleanPowerSF is a separate procurement/delivery example for city customers, not the assumed campus tariff.

stages.inventory_status: Existing park inventory unknown; campus not present.

diesel.label: Generic turf-stripping tractor
diesel.note: Authored average rate and fleet, including idling within the six engine-on hours. Not a manufacturer value or productivity estimate.

stages.inventory_status: Selected tractor fuel only; other site energy unknown.

diesel.label: Generic earthmoving excavators
diesel.note: Authored fleet and hours. Rate uses the midpoint of one manufacturer earthmoving example; actual grade volumes, machine class and productivity are unvalidated.

stages.inventory_status: Selected excavator fuel only; hauling, water trucks and other plant excluded.

diesel.label: Generic compaction roller
diesel.note: Authored fleet, average rate and engine-on hours including idling. No measured roller fuel or geotechnical production model.

stages.inventory_status: Selected roller fuel only; other energy unknown.

diesel.label: Generic on-site materials loader
diesel.note: Authored average rate, fleet and engine-on hours including idling. Selected on-site handling only.

electricity.label: Temporary tools, welfare and selected lifting allowance
electricity.note: Authored average electrical draw; not rated crane power. Hypothetical grid supply, not a confirmed temporary connection.

stages.inventory_status: Selected loader and temporary-electricity allowances; not all construction activities.

electricity.label: Selected commissioning grid tests
electricity.note: Authored aggregate average grid test draw, including its support loads. Partial tests over ten days, not a full-capacity IT test, acceptance protocol or application of annual PUE.
